native50MpScope: Real original 10000x5000 PNG source remains resident and its compressed bytes/dimensions are unchanged. Export retains native SVG geometry and fifty at-most-1024-square native coverage tiles. Exact alpha is decoded from ten small native-coordinate crops of the real output, including subtract holes across tile seams. This does not establish a full 50 MP SVG raster decode or peak browser memory.

separate50MpPngGate.description: Actual image import, source preservation, WASM edit, save/reopen and native-size PNG export

independentEvidence: Compound rectangle/hole SVG masks have direct expected interior samples for normal, inverted, partial-density and empty-inverted coverage; actual PNG comparison covers every output pixel.
All eleven parametrized full-coverage comparisons against actual native PNG are byte-exact for alpha and premultiplied RGB in this Chromium environment.
Two nested native masks retain six PNG tiles, with maximum one alpha-level and 2.019607843137255 premultiplied-value difference against native PNG under nested opacity/fill rounding.
All decoded native coverage PNGs have white RGB wherever alpha is nonzero, including a colored original bitmap with alpha 255/128/16/0. Original compressed source bytes are unchanged.

Actual export-owned native tile surfaces are released after first-tile cancellation, source removal/replacement and repository disposal. Cancellation can retry successfully; all scenarios leave document/revision unchanged.
Standalone attached-layer unlinked-mask output excludes ancestors and retains the mask in the correct parent-plane pixel position.
The exact documented masked SVG constructor example runs in the real isolated script runtime without changing active work.
Native mask editing, feather, painted corrections, cache/preview, history, project reopening and export regressions run against the shared final inversion/density helper.
limits: Native PNG mask preparation took 19682.9 ms in the single 50 MP trial. This is not a speedup, p95, input-to-photon, long-task, memory or universal responsiveness result.
Coverage buffers are bounded per tile plus existing feather/stroke buffers; compressed/base64 mask output and browser decoding still consume memory.
Native mask calls and browser PNG encoding cannot be preempted mid-call; cancellation checks surround awaits and tile/path boundaries.
Rasterized mask geometry/scaling is degraded and reported. Synchronous standalone toSvg rejects active masks requiring native preparation.
SVG Blend If, overlays/shadows, general SVG document import, non-vector/smart content, wider formats and broader fidelity/device gates remain incomplete.
No REST SVG renderer, new plugin privilege, public mutation DTO or document/project/workspace schema is added.
